# Tomato pruning

Pinch out the side shoots on cordon varieties once a week. Leave them on bush varieties.

Remove the leaves below the first truss when the fruit starts to colour, for airflow. Water at the base, never on the leaves. Stop the plant at five or six trusses so the last fruit ripens before the cold.
